symptom: `column (Attribute: Name, Filterable: true)` on a Data grid 2: the original report was a silent drop; on current main check refuses it, but with a project the message lists the column's properties without the `filter` slot, and without one it suggests `did you mean FilterType?` — a key the column does not have
cause: The refusal (MDL-WIDGET01 / MDL-WIDGET07) built its hint from property names only: the item's widgets slots (`content`, `filter`) are not properties, so neither the property list nor nearestKey over the builtin union could name the slot the author was reaching for
insight: Re-run an old silent-drop report on main before fixing it: #177 had already become a refusal, and what was left was the message. A did-you-mean over property names cannot reach a slot, so a key whose prefix is a slot key (`Filterable` → `filter`) needs its own answer naming the body form and the widget types the slot routes (itemSlotAcceptedChildTypes, already per widget). Measured on Mendix 11.13.0: the suggested `column (Attribute: X) { textfilter tf }` builds 0 errors. Control: both new assertions fail on main with `its properties are attribute, header (Caption)` and `did you mean FilterType`
